mapper.select: SELECT s.SCHEDULE_NO AS scheduleNo , r.REQUEST_NO AS requestNo , r.CUSTOMER_NAME AS customerName , r.CUSTOMER_TEL AS customerTel , r.CUSTOMER_ADDR AS customerAddr , r.PRODUCT_TYPE AS productType , r.SYMPTOM AS symptom , r.REQUEST_DATE AS requestDate FROM AS_SCHEDULE s JOIN AS_REQUEST r ON s.REQUEST_NO = r.REQUEST_NO WHERE s.SCHEDULE_NO = #{scheduleNo};
